neighbours.label: A list: 'ington' closing a name split after a double-r stem (Harrington, Arrington, Barrington, Parrington), and the Arabic pieces 'روب' and 'ب' in 'هروب' and 'حارب'; 'ington' after other stems (Billington, Addington), whole-token -ington names, and other Arabic words stay quiet.
fire: Coach Harrington picked the team on Friday.
Our neighbor Bob Arrington fixed the fence.
Senator Harrington spoke for an hour.
The Barrington library opens at nine.
Dr. Parrington read the old map.
قرر الجنود الهروب من المعسكر ليلا.
فكر السجين في الهروب من الزنزانة.
quiet: Coach Billington picked the team on Friday.
Our neighbor Bob Lexington fixed the fence.
Senator Washington spoke for an hour.
The Burlington library opens at nine.
Dr. Addington read the old map.
قرر الجنود الذهاب إلى المعسكر ليلا.
فكر السجين في أهله داخل الزنزانة.

notes: Probes: 'ington' 0.19-0.90 (Carrington 0.19), Arabic 0.44-0.67; Washington and Lexington are whole tokens, about 0. Whether r + 'ington' and Arabic r + b are one spelling distinction I can't say. 'ington' after other stems was not probed; two near misses test it.
